title: pyang configuration schema
description: JSON Schema for pyang Configuration JSON

useDefaults.description: Use default module search paths: current directory i.e. ".", $YANG_MODULEPATH, $HOME/yang/modules, $YANG_INSTALL/yang_modules e.g., /usr/share/yang/modules
useDefaults.markdownDescription: Use default module search paths: current directory i.e. `.`, `$YANG_MODULEPATH`, `$HOME/yang/modules`, `$YANG_INSTALL/yang_modules` e.g. `/usr/share/yang/modules`

paths.description: Additional search paths for imported modules

pathRecurse.description: If this parameter is set to "true", directories in the search paths are not recursively scanned for modules, except current directory i.e. "." which is never recursed
pathRecurse.markdownDescription: If this parameter is set to `true`, directories in the search paths are not recursively scanned for modules, except current directory i.e. `.` which is never recursed

ignorePaths.description: Paths which are ignored while searching for YANG modules. Can include path to YANG models. No glob patterns are supported.

rfc8407.description: Validate according to the generic YANG guideline as specified in RFC 8407
rfc8407.markdownDescription: Validate according to the generic YANG guideline as specified in [RFC 8407](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc8407)

canonical.description: Whether statements out of YANG RFC ABNF specified canonical order are flagged
canonical.markdownDescription: Whether statements out of [YANG RFC ABNF](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7950#section-14) specified canonical order are flagged

longLine.description: Give a warning if any line is longer than "length"
longLine.markdownDescription: Give a warning if any line is longer than `length`

longIdentifier.description: Give a warning if any identifier is longer than "length"
longIdentifier.markdownDescription: Give a warning if any identifier is longer than `length`

canonical.description: Whether statements should be reordered as per YANG RFC ABNF specified canonical order
canonical.markdownDescription: Whether statements should be reordered as per [YANG RFC ABNF](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7950#section-14) specified canonical order

removeUnusedImports.description: Remove unused import statements from the output

removeComments.description: Remove all comments from the output

indentSize.description: Format each line with this indentation

longLine.description: Try to format each line with a maximum line length of "length".  Does not reformat long lines within strings
longLine.markdownDescription: Try to format each line with a maximum line length of `length`.  Does not reformat long lines within strings
